patternTitle: Check your opponent’s strongest reply before you commit
patternLead: In many of your games, after a plausible move your opponent could answer right away with a capture, check, or forcing sequence that hurts your position. It does not mean you “don’t calculate”—it means a short test from your opponent’s side helps before you confirm.
patternHypothesis: You may stop once a move looks reasonable and skip imagining your opponent’s most uncomfortable reply.
skill1Desc: After you pick a candidate, look for the most awkward forced reply (capture, check, short line).
skill2Desc: Include strong checks and captures among your candidates before comparing quiet plans.
skill3Desc: Before you capture, check the recapture, hanging pieces, and your opponent’s first tactical reply.
